description: Neobem is a command-line preprocessor language published by the mitchpaulus repository for generating building-energy simulation inputs. It compiles expressions, variables, reusable templates and loops into EnergyPlus IDF files and also supports DOE-2 Building Description Language. Excel and JSON data can supply objects, and text can be read from a file or standard input and written to standard output. The repository documents source builds and releases for Windows, Linux and macOS architectures. Source is free under AGPL-3.0. Coverage is the user's building and chosen simulation period, without a fixed geographic dataset or physical resolution. The main caveat is that Neobem prepares text inputs, not checking the physical adequacy of a model or running its solver. Release choice also matters: some builds bundle a .NET runtime, while smaller builds need a matching runtime installed separately. It supports repeatable input generation for parameter studies and reusable model components around the catalogue's EnergyPlus engine (model-energyplus). No executable or archive was downloaded for this review.
